row.title: Copies drift silently unless one source generates them and a check compares
row.body: On 2026-11-25 the seed template was 132 files behind seed/ (kit-sync never copies workflows), satellite agent files told agents a human must review protected changes, two tenant repos had no settings entry, a hosted boot still asked for three tokens, six seed workflows ignored HALT. Fix: seed/doctrine/system.json as the one definition, coherence --check in checks, a daily clean room. Limit: a sandbox reaches 'ticking' only; critical needs real deploys and is read from live systems.
